subject: English
passage: Norwegian composer Edvard Grieg's Piano Concerto in A minor consists of three interconnected movements built around a central melodic theme that appears in various forms throughout the work. The recurring use of this theme, according to ______ reflects his belief that "music should tell a story that unfolds across time."
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation: Choice C is the best answer. The phrase "according to Grieg" is an aside that interrupts the flow of the sentence, so it needs to be separated from the sentence with a pair of matching punctuation marks: two commas, two dashes, or a pair of parentheses. We already have a comma before "according," so we must add a comma after "Grieg."
